name: Helping One Another
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to live in unity and mutual care, sharing their resources and serving one another in love as an expression of Christian liberty (Acts 2:44; Galatians 5:13). This mutual support includes bearing each other's burdens, which fulfills the law of Christ and reflects the deep spiritual unity that transcends all cultural and social distinctions (Galatians 6:2; Colossians 3:11). Helping one another is therefore a vital outworking of the gospel, grounded in the reality that Christ is all and in all.
